name: tenuto-studio-5
description: Tenuto Studio 5 - Declarative Code-to-Music Studio and Scrolling Piano Roll Player
author: Alec Borman

scripts.clean:bloat: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public/assets/aistudio','Case Study.md','Nocturene and Protocol of the Glass Leviathan.txt','proposal_delta.json','session_state.tela','tenuto_daw_architecture_specification.md','tenuto_studio_5_6_0_architecture.md'].forEach(p=>fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}));"
scripts.electron:build:mac: vite build && npx --yes electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac pkg --arm64
scripts.electron:build:win: vite build && npx --yes electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64
